title: Person Portfolio (frontmatter)
description: Validates the YAML-style frontmatter of each crm/people/*.md portfolio. The markdown body below the frontmatter holds the narrative: summary, interaction timeline, asks/commitments, notes.

id.description: Kebab-case slug, matches the filename (crm/people/<id>.md). Never changes once created.

name.description: Full name. Use 'TBD (email@domain)' only while unresolved.

emails.description: All known addresses for this person. Aliases merge here — one person, one portfolio.

category.description: professional = networking/job-search/business; service = doctors, vendors, support.

how_met.description: Origin story: intro, cold outreach, event, existing relationship.

intro_by.description: Portfolio id or name of the person who made the introduction.

interaction_count.description: Total logged interactions in the window (emails sent/received + meetings).

channels.description: Channels actually used with this person.

stage.description: Mirrors the NetworkingCRM app pipeline stages.

status.description: draft = machine-generated, unreviewed. verified = human-confirmed facts.
